review.reviewBasis: Actual paired GAME/Esri250m ground-plane crop sheets inspected. Coverage review does not establish photographic identity, unknown-height resolution or native drone acceptance.

sheets.finding: All24 northern airfield/cargo/approach/ring cells inspected. Runway/taxiway markings and physical widths, apron equipment/occupancy, roof details, commercial car-lot density and ring vegetation remain visibly simplified. Exact source bodies/ways are retained; low measured/inferred tree coverage outside mapped sample extents remains visible. Generic roofs, surface materials and roadway/parcel terrain are not real-world parity. The4 representative measured aircraft do not represent all reference aircraft or a current fleet.

All12 taxiway/cargo/highway/low-rise cells inspected. Source footprint and street arrangement remain; commercial rooftop equipment/material, physical taxiway width/marking, vehicle-lot occupancy, residential roofs/facades and measured crown/species detail remain simplified. Sparse vegetation outside measured coverage and the exact600m source boundary are visible. Roof projection under the perspective250m atlas differs from a ground-orthographic reference; no unsupported dimensions are inferred.

All12 residential, taxiway, apron-edge, car-lot and approach cells inspected. Dense measured crowns and source footprints remain; species/height/canopy model, estimated residential roof geometry, parking occupancy, rooftop detail, taxiway widths/markings and ground/embankment terrain differ. Source roof attributes retain independent provenance and OSM priority; no blanket parity claim.

All12 ring-residential/taxiway/expressway/open-space cells inspected. Generic source roofs/materials and parking layout/occupancy remain; the northern apron and taxiway surface/marking and airport support detail remain simplified. Reference acquisition date, real absolute terrain/road elevations and unsupported height/detail remain unknown. Measured crowns cover the independently surveyed region, with sparse outside detail explicitly visible.

All12 north-satellite/apron, taxiway, hotel/car-lot and residential cells inspected. Mapped concourse outline and source road/roof layout retained. Terminal roof equipment, jet-bridge details, full apron fleet/ground-support occupancy, taxiway markings/width, parking occupancy, residential roof/style and outer vegetation remain simplified. Four representative measured aircraft are not a current/full fleet claim.

All12 main-terminal/concourse/garage, approach, runway and residential cells inspected. Corrected representative aircraft are on airside in the expected source context. Original terminal/garage outlines and lightwells remain; roofs/equipment, canopy/jet-bridge/frontage detail, apron fleet/ground support, parking occupancy, terrain and crown detail remain simplified. Provider imagery includes apparent construction/date differences; acquisition date is unknown and original current source bodies remain intact. No facade/height facts extracted from references.

All24 terminal/garage/approach, southern-apron, hotel/residential and lake cells inspected. Exact source arrangements, garage lightwells, corrected representative airside aircraft and source water outline remain. Airport roof/jet-bridge/support/marking/equipment detail, full fleet/lot occupancy, unknown vertical terrain and roof geometry, materials and dense crown/species detail remain visibly limited. Lake colour/shallow shore depiction and provider shadows do not establish measured bathymetry or capture-date identity. Sparse outer-ring vegetation and source-boundary presentation remain explicit.

Final7 south-commercial/residential and3explicit distant-context cells inspected. Source footprint/road/water arrangements are retained but estimated roof/storeys/material, vehicle-lot occupancy, utility/vegetation and parcel details differ. The3outside-ring frames deliberately expose sparse distant/context representation and are separate from core+600m coverage. They do not establish full surrounding-neighborhood parity.

additionalFindings.note: Visible passive scenery terrain-model/body-contact gap beyond150m legal dronebuffer. The native1.929m query remains blocked; no scenery parity. Production exact flight-domain proof excludes the contact; no core edges join the source upperway/junction. Bare-earth terrain does not measure the omitted deck/clearance.
